items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Marek Weber in the context of the interviewee's associate (Danny Polo) working with him, and the interviewer asks if 'He' (Danny Polo) was working full-time with that band. The interviewee (Arthur Briggs) does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Marek We

ctx.x: She went and invited the managing directors of the different recording companies to come and listen to the orchestra.
She also invited all of the top band leaders, like Marek Weber, and Darius Bela, Ephaim Schachtmeister, and who else?
Oh, yes, Norbert Fraconi. And she had them all to come to the Barbarina and listen to the orchestra and everything. So, she really sent the orchestra.
